workspace.capability.limit.externalRoot: While a folder on your device is selected as the workspace, command execution is unavailable: a shell without root cannot reach that folder, so only file reads and writes work.
workspace.capability.limit.githubImport: GitHub import = branch snapshot (zip download + extract), no git history; commits go through the agent’s GitHub tools; delete/force operations are permanently forbidden.
workspace.capability.limit.localModel: Local models currently do not take part in the tool loop: on-device inference falls back to plain chat and never reads or edits files.
workspace.capability.limit.shellScope: Commands run inside the app sandbox and can reach public paths such as /system/bin; this is not a full terminal for your phone, and it cannot touch other apps’ data.
workspace.capability.limit.shellSwitch: Command execution is off by default and needs a separate switch; even then every command asks for its own confirmation, and denying it means it never runs.
workspace.capability.limit.tools: File tools only work in Read-only and Editable modes; in Ask mode it is pure chat and no file is ever read.
workspace.capability.step.answer: The model keeps going on that result — possibly several rounds — and finally answers.
workspace.capability.step.compose: The app joins the system prompt and conversation context and sends them to the model.
workspace.capability.step.decide: The model decides to call a tool (read, write or edit a file, or run a command).
workspace.capability.step.execute: The app runs the tool and hands the result back to the model.
workspace.capability.step.receive: It receives your request (the message you send in chat).
